<includeonly><infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="author"><label>Author(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="cover artist"><label>Cover artist</label></data>
        <data source="illustrator"><label>Illustrator</label></data>
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>
        <data source="game"><label>Game</label></data>
        <data source="published in"><label>Published in</label></data>
        <data source="reprinted in"><label>Reprinted in</label></data>
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>     
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>   
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronology</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="campaign"><label>Campaign</label></data>	
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Adventure|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|author|cover artist|illustrator|editor|publisher|game|published in|reprinted in|release date|pages|timeline|campaign|preceded by|followed by|optional=no_year_check,not_appearance,unlicensed}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|misc={{{unlicensed|}}}|stories=1|image_optional=1|template_name=Adventure|unlicensed={{{unlicensed|}}}}}<!--
-->{{AppMediaCat|not_appearance={{{not_appearance|}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>[[Category:Media infoboxes]]{{Clear}}
